production_rule: No mixture-of-experts fair-value path is used in the live paper champion. Each model must emit the economic object it is designed to estimate and use a matching execution style.
semantic_role: Contract parsing, entity extraction, threshold-family construction and logical relation discovery. Semantic similarity alone must never create a fair probability or trade.

micro.rule: Short-horizon microstructure targets are causally labeled. Taker decisions use an uncertainty lower bound, displayed-depth VWAP and short-horizon mean-variance sizing rather than binary Kelly.

local_factor.rule: Many local factor models are allowed; the production challenger estimates the latent factor on aligned logit returns with exponentially weighted loadings, then tests the factor-neutral residual state for mean reversion under BH-FDR.

graph_hard.rule: Hard event arbitrage requires a Gamma-verified complete active outcome set and full live book revalidation before entry.

external.rule: Universalize the signal interface, not the domain model. Sources remain specialist and point-in-time.

execution_contract.displayed_depth: Every taker admission and exit must walk the displayed ladder for the intended size. Insufficient depth is a rejection, never extrapolated liquidity.
execution_contract.fees: Use market-specific fee information when available, with an explicit conservative fallback only when the public endpoint is unavailable.
execution_contract.slippage: Residual slippage is state-dependent after depth walking and increases with spread, short volatility and participation while decreasing with liquidity.
execution_contract.maker_queue: Passive quoting must model queue ahead and reject extreme queue/order ratios before posting; cancel/replace resets priority.
execution_contract.uncertainty: Model-driven taker alpha is admitted on a lower-confidence-bound executable edge, not point-estimate edge.
execution_contract.sizing: Short-horizon relative-value and microstructure signals use bounded risk-budget or mean-variance sizing; terminal binary Kelly is not reused across unrelated economic objects.
execution_contract.real_money: No authenticated order path is enabled by this architecture. User-channel reconciliation, balances/allowances, FOK/FAK semantics and production kill switches remain a separate reviewed live adapter.

global_risk_contract.scope: A single scenario-risk observer sits above all capital-isolated sleeves and reconciles their durable equity, gross exposure and kill state.
global_risk_contract.persistence: A global kill flag is sticky across process restarts and cannot self-clear.
global_risk_contract.startup: Missing child marks are tolerated only during an explicit bounded startup grace period; afterwards the observer fails closed.
global_risk_contract.scenario_rule: Open gross is shocked by sleeve-specific conservative loss multipliers before admitting continued operation.

operability_contract.rule: A silent model is a defect. A model may abstain, but it must publish the exact reason distribution and the scheduler must distinguish no alpha, failed data, failed execution and failed risk admission.
operability_contract.aggressiveness: Increase operations by expanding valid edge sources, maker participation, local models and executable relation coverage. Do not manufacture trades by ignoring costs, uncertainty, depth or logical completeness.

scheduler_directive.all_schedulers: Treat V6 model, execution and global-risk contracts as authoritative. Research that reintroduces semantic peer averaging, global heterogeneous level PCA, midpoint-only hard arbitrage, fixed fictitious liquidity or a live fair-value mixture is non-promotable.
scheduler_directive.alpha_factory: Maintain challengers separately for micro, local_factor, graph_hard, graph_rv, structural and external; rank by executable OOS utility and incremental trade coverage after uncertainty and cost stress.
scheduler_directive.forward_maker: Optimize micro maker fill EV and adverse selection with queue-aware admission; test short-horizon taker forecasts separately.
scheduler_directive.fast_arb: Prioritize executable graph_hard relations and full multi-leg VWAP revalidation.
scheduler_directive.arb_theory: Expand proof-backed implication, exhaustive-event and structural payoff relations, then emit standardized intents.
scheduler_directive.external_intelligence: Produce timestamped specialist probabilities only after point-in-time match validation and OOS evidence.
scheduler_directive.promotion_controller: Promotion must preserve the V6 contracts and require exact-source OOS evidence, cost stress, drawdown control, data health, scenario-risk health and non-degrading incremental utility.
scheduler_directive.monitoring: Expose model coverage, rejections, emitted bundles, fills, PnL, global gross and scenario loss by V6 family and execution mode.
